about: Edge-pinned elements that are exempt from the safe-area inset rule, as "<file under src>:<edge>". Read by scripts/check-safe-area.mjs as EXEMPT; changed through a hand-in patch applied by the integrator, never by hand in a slot. One reason per entry: an exemption is a written decision. The gate fails on an entry whose file no longer exists.

entries.ui/feedback/variants/E14E20.tsx:top: the sheet pins to the BOTTOM; its top-0 case is the centred dialog, which never touches an edge
entries.ui/shell/OfflineIndicator.tsx:bottom: sticky to the top of the layout column; it never reaches the bottom edge
